_about: Comment prompts for the daily Reel and carousel captions (scripts/social-content.mjs). One per caption, chosen by date so it rotates; the first comment on Instagram and Facebook uses the next one in the list. {from} is the sending country (UK, US, Europe…), {to} the receiving country, {city} the city of a house reel, {material} the material of a material-price reel. Keep each one short, one line, a question.
